name: ghost-typist
description: Types out the code the agent writes, live, in a side pane with keyboard sounds

wpm.title: Typing speed (WPM)
wpm.description: Base typing speed; it speeds up when it falls behind the model

autoOpen.title: Open the pane automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when the agent starts writing (needs a wide terminal)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: watch: it types by itself. hacker: each key you press in the pane types a few characters
